nodes.prompt: Read the objective and the repository. Produce a compact implementation plan and the acceptance criteria you would verify. Do not edit files.
Implement the objective in this isolated worktree. Keep the change small, stay inside the write scopes, and do not commit.
Review the implementation in this worktree against the objective. Do not edit files. Report done only when no blocking finding remains.
Read the diff and the review before publishing the isolated branch.
